proposals.defect: Image mode validation is moved before the dimension bounds checks, and the size checks only run for supported modes, so an unsupported-mode image that is also out of bounds is reported with a different error, and oversized/undersized images in unsupported modes skip the size checks entirely.

Minimum/maximum bounds only checked against width for the upper bound and require both dimensions below min (and instead of or) for the lower bound, so images with only one invalid dimension (e.g. very tall thin image) slip through validation before provider execution.
